funding: Manually fund the single disposable wallet with Testnet APT. The initial estimate is 0.1 APT for registration, storage, and transaction fees. The public faucet may require authentication.
history: On-chain tables store registered addresses, entries keyed by sender and operation ID, and per-account activity keys. Native fungible-asset balances include transfers outside PayMVC.
confirmation: Committed successful user transaction plus verified application effect. Expiry requires committed ledger time, retained history covering preparation, and a second absent-hash lookup.
